verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single pricing-page line saying ClickHouse Cloud lets you export backups to your own cloud account. That implies the product has a first-party backup capability, but nothing shows backups run automatically on a schedule the founder can see and configure, or that restores are self-serve. missing for 10: documented automatic backup schedule, user-visible and configurable schedule and retention controls, self-serve restore workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, automatic backups run on a schedule I can see and configure, and restores are self-serve

citations.quote: Export backups to your own cloud account
